summary: A pure, derived (not stored) function role_criticality(role) -> {approve_or_transition, external_invoke, sensitive_read} + level, computed from the role's grant rows (joined via grant.role_id) + the data_classification table; the three bits encode the signed D-A=A3 axes and feed T-0044's dual-control gate, which T-0040 does NOT build.
functional: FR-1: input is the role's Grant rows (grant.role_id == role id, one tenant) via an injected RoleGrantSource.getRoleGrants port; the function does no IO (Postgres JOIN deferred to T-0053)
FR-2: approve_or_transition === true iff the role holds >=1 effective grant with operation in {approve, transition} (the guarded-transition op-classes)
FR-3: external_invoke === true iff the role holds >=1 effective grant with resourceType === 'effect_resource' AND operation === 'invoke' (the T-0034 verifyEffectGrants predicate)

FR-4: sensitive_read === true iff deriveClearance(effective read grants, nowMs) yields a DataClass whose rank >= rank(SENSITIVE_READ_THRESHOLD = 'confidential'); public/internal clearance does not set the bit (the 'above a threshold' carveout)
FR-5: level === 'critical' iff any of the three bits is true, else 'routine' — the single-approver carveout (routine = T-0044 single-approver path, critical = two-approver path)
FR-6: only effective grants count — every bit consults grants with isEffective(grant, nowMs) === true; nowMs is a parameter (no Date.now in core)
FR-7: returns a frozen RoleCriticality record + a criticalityDiff(from, to) helper that T-0044 consumes; T-0040 owns the computation and record shape, T-0044 owns the gate
FR-8: tenant isolation is derived — grants are pre-scoped to one tenant by the injected port; the function adds no cross-tenant edge and reads no global store

FR-9: src/core/role-criticality.ts exports RoleCriticality, RoleCriticalityLevel, RoleGrantSource, roleCriticality, combineCriticality, criticalityLevel, criticalityDiff, SENSITIVE_READ_THRESHOLD; T-0044 imports them without re-declaration or cast
non_functional: NF-1: src/core/role-criticality.ts imports no pg/fs/net/http; all DB access behind the injected RoleGrantSource port (in-memory now, Postgres DAO in T-0053)
NF-2: rights-derived-only — every bit derives solely from Grant rows (T-0018 predicates) + DataClass (T-0033 deriveClearance); no parallel criticality store, no second algebra
NF-3: fail-closed / fail-critical bias — doubt resolves toward MORE criticality; a corrupt/unknown operation or null clearance never silently lowers a bit
NF-4: no new npm dependency (zero-dep TS/stdlib)
NF-5: commit does not edit grant-lattice.ts, data-classification.ts, effect-resource.ts, grant-resolver.ts, object-handle.ts, or any migration; tsc --noEmit passes
NF-6: no migration added — role_criticality is derived, not stored; migration seam 030+ stays unused; no change to known_tenant_tables.txt or the cross-tenant fitness set
NF-7: determinism — roleCriticality/combineCriticality called twice with same inputs yield deep-equal output; no IO outside the injected port

Materializing criticality into a column/table/row — deferred to T-0053 if performance ever requires; day-1 is the pure function

acceptance_criteria.text: approve_or_transition true on approve grant: combineCriticality([grant{operation:'approve', effective}], nowMs).approve_or_transition === true
approve_or_transition true on transition grant: combineCriticality([grant{operation:'transition', effective}], nowMs).approve_or_transition === true
approve_or_transition false without approve/transition: a role holding only {read,create,update,delete} grants yields approve_or_transition === false
external_invoke true: combineCriticality([grant{resourceType:'effect_resource', operation:'invoke', effective}], nowMs).external_invoke === true
external_invoke false on non-effect invoke: a grant with operation 'invoke' but resourceType !== 'effect_resource' does NOT set external_invoke
external_invoke false on effect_resource non-invoke: a grant resourceType 'effect_resource' with operation 'read' does NOT set external_invoke
sensitive_read true at/above threshold: a read grant conferring clearance 'confidential' (via constraint.clearance) yields sensitive_read === true; 'restricted' also true
sensitive_read false below threshold: a read grant conferring only 'internal' or 'public' clearance, or no clearance marker, yields sensitive_read === false (the threshold carveout)
sensitive_read keys on read op only: a 'confidential'-clearance grant whose operation is 'approve' (not 'read') does not set sensitive_read

level critical iff any bit: criticalityLevel returns 'critical' when at least one of the three bits is true, and 'routine' iff all three are false (single-approver carveout distinguishable from the unsafe case)
effective-window honored: an out-of-window grant (isEffective(grant,nowMs)===false) contributes ZERO to all three bits; the same grant in-window flips its bit

criticalityDiff expansion: criticalityDiff(from,to) sets expanded.<bit>===true iff to.<bit>===true && from.<bit>===false, and escalates===true iff to.level==='critical' && from.level!=='critical'; a true->false narrowing or any cosmetic same-state does not escalate

fail-closed unknown operation: a grant whose operation is not in the closed Operation set never lowers a bit (it is ignored for axes, never used to clear approve_or_transition); doubt resolves toward more criticality
determinism/purity: combineCriticality and roleCriticality called twice with identical inputs yield deep-equal outputs; no IO outside the injected RoleGrantSource port
